$comment: Inline citation labels in a generated note ([S7 E1], [S8], [A2], [S4 E1 Patient 00:12]) and their removal for EMR / export text. The stored HOPE note, its versions and the console keep the labels; only text leaving HOPE for an EMR (Copy to EMR, Copy note, export) is stripped. Implementations: @arcaai/types citation-labels.ts (TS, re-exported by both SDKs), the ALaaS svc and web_ui ports, and the harness coverage regex (apps/harness/src/harness/services/note_plan/coverage.py _BRACKETED_LABEL). Every implementation must reproduce every case exactly.

label.description: A bracket that opens with S|A|R + digits (segment, attachment, recap source), optionally followed by a space and any text up to the closing bracket on the same line. Case-sensitive. Anything else in brackets is not a label.

steps: 1. Leading labels: multiline replace ^([ \t]*)(?:LABEL[ \t]*)+ with $1 (keep the indentation, drop the labels and the spaces after them).
2. Every remaining label: replace [ \t]*LABEL with the empty string (drop the label and the spaces before it).
Nothing else changes: line breaks, blank lines, markdown and other brackets are kept byte for byte.

labels.description: labelsOf(text) returns the inner text of every label occurrence, in order, not de-duplicated (what a hover chip shows).
